title: Multiple main landmarks
user_impact: Screen reader users who jump to the main content cannot tell which region is meant.
technical_impact: More than one element with role="main" (implicit or explicit).

checks.source: HTML §4.4.14 the main element (at most one main without the hidden attribute); WAI-ARIA 1.2 main; axe landmark-no-duplicate-main
checks.applicability: Documents with at least one rendered main landmark.
checks.expectation:
Flags a document with more than one rendered main landmark (main or
role="main"), at the second one. A main with the hidden attribute does not
count: HTML explicitly allows hidden alternative views. Best practice without
a criterion since 4.1.1 was removed.
